content: Mmbe, ringʼana rɨnʉ nikwenda kʉbhabhʉʉrɨra nɨ‑kʉbha, wʉwʉʉsi wʉnʉ akʉgabha ebhegero bhya wiisɨ akɨɨrɨ mwana, atakɨrɨɨnɨ na mbʉʉsa, nangabha ebhegero bhyʉsi ibhyazɨ.
Ribhaga ryʉsi, ʉmʉgabhi ahaabha ari iyaasɨ wa abharɨri na abhaatʉ bhanʉ bhakwimɨɨrɨrɨra ebhegero bhyazɨ, kuhika ribhaga rɨnʉ wiisɨ ɨɨndirɨ.
Na niitwɨ ɨbhuɨbhu, ribhaga rɨnʉ Kiriisitʉ aarɨ akɨɨrɨ kuuza, twarɨ ncha abhaana, twarɨ bhambʉʉsa bhi isimʉka yɨnʉ ɨkʉkangata ɨɨsɨ.
Nawe hanʉ ryahikirɨ ribhaga rɨnʉ ryatɨɨrwɨ, Mungu akatʉma Umwana waazɨ kʉʉsɨ, akiibhurwa nʉ ʉmʉkari, mumigirʉ ja Musa.
Akatumwa asabhʉrɨ bhanʉ twarɨ bhambʉʉsa bhi imigirʉ ja Musa, korereke itwʉsi tʉbhɨ abhaana bha Mungu.
Mungu akatʉma Ekoro yu Umwana waazɨ mumyʉyʉ jɨtʉ, kʉ kʉbha nɨ‑bhaana bhaazɨ tʉrɨ. Ekoro yiyo neyo ikugirya tʉbhɨrɨkɨrɨ Mungu, “Bhaabha.”
Nangʉ imwɨ mʉtarɨ bhambʉʉsa naatu, nawe nɨ‑bhaana bha Mungu. Na kʉ kʉbha nɨ‑bhaana, Mungu arabhagabhya.
Paaurʉ arabhahama Abhagaraatiya
Ɨkarɨ hanʉ mwarɨ mʉtɨɨzɨ Mungu, mwarɨ bhambʉʉsa bha amasambwa ganʉ gatarɨ Mungu.
Nawe nangʉ, mumwɨzɨ Mungu, wʉʉsi abhɨɨzɨ bhʉkʉngʼu. Kwakɨ moreenda kʉgarʉka kosengera isimʉka yɨnʉ ɨkʉkangata ɨɨsɨ, yɨnʉ ɨtaana ʉbhʉnaja nu ubhwera bhwʉbhwʉsi? Moreenda kʉbha bhambʉʉsa bhaabhʉ?
Mʉkɨɨrɨ mʉragwata zisigukuru zɨ Ɨkɨyaahudi? Mʉragwata zisikʉ zi imyɨri na zu umwaka, kʉbha ni‑zisigukuru zʉ ʉkʉsʉʉka Mungu?
Nɨrʉʉbhaha hamwɨ emeremo gɨnʉ nakʉrirɨ igʉrʉ waanyu, girimiirɨ bhʉʉha.
Abhahiiri bhaanɨ, nɨrabhasabha mʉbhɨ bhu ubhwiyagaaruri ncha niinyɨ, kʉ kʉbha na niinyɨ ɨkarɨ naarɨ nangi imwɨ. Hanʉ naarɨ hamwɨmwɨ na niimwɨ, mʉtankʉrɨɨrɨ ʉbhʉbhɨ bhwʉbhwʉsi.
Mwɨzɨ kʉbha, ubhurwɨrɨ bhʉnʉ naarɨ nabhwɨ, nebhwe bhwagiriryɨ nɨkabhona umweya gu ukubharwazɨra Ɨngʼana Ɨnzʉmu.
Nangabha nɨkarorekanabhu, mʉtaandɨgirɨ naabha kʉnyanga. Nawe kɨnʉ mwakʉrirɨ ni‑kunyiisirirya chɨmbu mwangiisiriiryɨ maraika wa Mungu, hamwɨ kwisirirya Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ.
Ribhaga rirya mwarɨ no obhozomerwa, nangʉ kɨbhʉnɨkirɨkɨ? Nɨragamba amaheene kʉbha, ribhaga rirya mwangaturirɨ kwiha amɨɨsʉ gaanyu na kongʼa.
Awɨɨ nangʉ, nɨbhɨɨrɨ umubhisa waanyu kʉ kʉbhabhʉʉrɨra amaheene?
Abhaatʉ abhandɨ bhayo bharakaja kʉbhanyaakɨra, nawe kɨnʉ bhakʉbhamoherya kɨtarɨ kɨzʉmu. Bhareenda kʉbhataanʼya na niinyɨ, korereke mʉbhanyaakɨrɨ ebho.
Maheene ni‑ngʼana izʉmu kʉbhanyaakɨra abhandɨ sikʉ zʉʉsi kʉmangʼana amazʉmu. Mokorebhu nʉʉrʉ hanʉ nɨkʉbha nɨtarɨ hamwɨmwɨ na niimwɨ.
Abhaana bhaanɨ, nirumirwɨ naatu ʉbhʉsʉngʉ igʉrʉ waanyu, chɨmbu ʉmʉkari wɨ ɨnda ahaarumwa ʉbhʉsʉngʉ. Niriiyigwa ɨbhuɨbhu, kuhika hanʉ eteemwa ya Kiriisitʉ ɨraarorekanɨ mozeteemwa zaanyu.
Nangabhɨɨrɨ hamwɨmwɨ na niimwɨ nangwɨnʉ, hamwɨ naarɨ nɨragamba na niimwɨ kwa bhʉnyʉʉhu. Nɨna makɨbhwɨ igʉrʉ waanyu!
Ekerenjo cha Hajira na Saara
Mʉmbʉʉrɨrɨ bhanʉ mukwenda kwikara iyaasɨ wi imigirʉ ja Musa, mʉtɨɨzɨ chɨmbu imigirʉ gikubhuga?
Yandikirwɨ mʉMaandɨkʉ Amarɨndu kʉbha, Abhurahaamu aarɨ na abhaana bhabhɨrɨ. Ʉwʉmwɨ akiibhʉra na mbʉʉsa waazɨ Hajira, nʉ ʉwʉndɨ akiibhʉra na Saara mʉkaazɨ we ebhegero.
Umwana wa mbʉʉsa akiibhurwa kʉsɨɨmi ya abhaatʉ. Nawe umwana wa mʉkaazɨ we ebhegero, ewe akiibhurwa kʉbhʉragɨ bhwa Mungu.

Abhakari bhayo bharatʉra kogegwa nche ebherenjo bhyʉ ʉbhʉragɨ. Hajira, ne‑kerenjo chʉ ʉbhʉragɨ bhwe embere rɨnʉ ryakʉrirwɨ kʉkɨgʉrʉ cha Sinayi. Abhaana bhaazɨ bhakiibhurwa ncha bhambʉʉsa iyaasɨ wi imigirʉ ja Musa.

Abhaatʉ bha Yɨrusarɨɨmu bha nangwɨnʉ, nɨ‑bhambʉʉsa iyaasɨ wi imigirʉ ja Musa. Bhayo nɨ‑bhambʉʉsa ncha abhaana bha Hajira wʉnʉ akutuubhanibhwa nʉ ʉbhʉragɨ bhʉnʉ Mungu aakʉrirɨ kʉkɨgʉrʉ cha Sinayi mucharʉ cha Arabhiya.
Nawe Saara ariimɨɨrɨra kʉbha ʉrʉbhɨri rwa Yɨrusarɨɨmu mwisaarʉ, nɨ‑rʉbhɨri rʉnʉ runu ubhwiyagaaruri, na ruyo nerwe yiiya wɨɨtʉ itwɨ.
Yandikirwɨ MʉMaandɨkʉ Amarɨndu igʉrʉ waazɨ,

content.text: tiirya riraka wʉnʉ ʉkɨɨrɨ kwigwa ʉbhʉsʉngʉ bhu ukwitʉʉranʼya umwana,
kʉ kʉbha abhaana bha wʉnʉ aarɨ atigirwɨ umwene nɨ‑bhaaru,
kʉkɨra wʉnʉ aarɨ nu umusubhɨ waazɨ.”

content: Mmbe, nangʉ abhahiiri bhaanɨ, imwɨ nɨ‑bhaana kurwa kʉ ʉbhʉragɨ bhwa Mungu, chɨmbu Iisaka aarɨ.
Nawe zisikʉ zirya, umwana wʉnʉ iibhwirwɨ kʉsɨɨmi ya abhaatʉ, akanyaacha umwana wʉnʉ iibhwirwɨ kʉbhʉnaja bhwe Ekoro Ɨndɨndu. Na sikʉ zɨnʉ hʉʉsi nɨmbu ɨrɨ.
Nawe Amaandɨkʉ Amarɨndu garabhugabhwɨ? Garabhuga, “Heebha ʉmʉkari mbʉʉsa hamwɨmwɨ nu umwana waazɨ, kʉ kʉbha umwana wa mbʉʉsa, atakʉtʉra kʉgabha hamwɨmwɨ nu umwana wʉ ʉmʉkari we ebhegero.”
Abhahiiri bhaanɨ, itwɨ tʉtarɨ abhaana bha mbʉʉsa, nawe nɨ‑bhaana bhʉ ʉmʉkari we ebhegero.

footnotes.text: Isimʉka yɨnʉ ɨkʉkangata ɨɨsɨ, ʉbhʉgaruri ʉbhʉndɨ bhʉratʉra kʉbha, amasambwa ganʉ gakʉkangata ɨɨsɨ. Nɨmbu ɨrɨ nʉ ʉrʉkɨrɨrɨ 4:9.
